crates/xpute/core/src/kit/fdlibm.rs: JavaScript's Math builtins, as FreeBSD msun computes them, so a result is the same bits on every toolchain: the pair of a runtime global, not of a file.
crates/xpute/core/src/kit/json.rs: JSON.stringify and JSON.parse of a flat string map, the host's JSON for the records' tags, and JSON read where it lies for a module with no heap: the pair of a runtime global, not of a file.
crates/xpute/core/src/sys/console.rs: JavaScript's console global; the host installs one.
packages/xpute/core/src/kit/word.ts: Integer types, casts, fit checks and masked shifts for a language that has only doubles and BigInt: Rust's primitives and `as`. A consumer uses the primitive.
packages/xpute/core/src/ds/treap_set.ts#: Type-level union (string | number | bigint) the set does not use; the set is generic over its comparator.
packages/xpute/core/src/kit/type.ts: Type-level utilities (Async<T>, Nullable<T>): the type system's — Option<T>.
packages/xpute/core/src/kit/cast.ts: Bit-pattern reinterpretation at a width, for a language with only doubles and BigInt: `as` casts here.
packages/xpute/core/src/kit/detect_env.t: Runtime detection (browser, worker, Node): the host's; the module has one runtime.
packages/xpute/core/src/kit/iter.ts: Generator adapters over iterables (dedupe, except, take, filter): the Iterator trait's own adapters.
packages/xpute/core/src/kit/lower.ts: JS-side lowering of plain objects (Object.getPrototypeOf, key ordering) for the tree frontends: JavaScript's object model; the module lowers typed values.
packages/xpute/core/src/io/json_codec.ts: JSON encode/decode with the host's JSON: the host's; nothing the module exchanges is JSON.
packages/xpute/core/src/ipc/link.ts: The transport — postMessage transfer, structured clone, the microtask queue: the host's. The module's link is the ring.
crates/xpute/core/src/sys/vector.rs: The vectors' reader, test-only; its writer is script/pair.ts, not a file of the kit.
packages/xpute/core/src/sys/mem.ts#reser: The central scheduler's reservation of a WebAssembly.Memory: the host's. The module is given its memory and lays out what is inside it.
packages/xpute/core/src/ipc/doorbell.ts: The host's end of a guest's rings: it rings the guest and reads what comes back. The guest is rung, never rings; its end is the rings themselves (ipc/ring.rs) and its own export.
packages/xpute/core/src/sched/strobe.ts: The central scheduler's clock for a guest, on the host's animation frames and timers. The guest is strobed, never strobes.
packages/xpute/core/src/sys/slab.ts: The central scheduler's little memory: ArrayBuffers moved between the host's threads by transfer. The host's; the module never holds one.
crates/xpute/core/src/sched/task.rs: A guest's executor interface and its one install point, as GlobalAlloc and #[global_allocator] are for memory. The host is never a guest; its turns are sched/strobe.ts.
crates/xpute/core/src/sched/edge.rs: A guest's side of the turn: the quota as a deadline, the tasks parked for the next rising edge, and the falling edge's ask. The host is never a guest; its side is sched/quantum.ts and sched/strobe.ts.
crates/xpute/core/src/ds/buddy_tree.rs: evanw/buddy-malloc in Rust: a buddy over one fixed range as a linearized binary tree, with the growth and the per-allocation header taken out. The pair of a C file, not of a TypeScript one — the host has no use for it, since the range it manages is the module's own memory.
crates/xpute/core/src/ds/slab.rs: Size classes over ds/buddy_tree.rs, the pair of a level Linux keeps in the kernel: the module's own `#[global_allocator]`, over the one linear memory it was given. The host allocates with `new`, so there is nothing here for it.
crates/xpute/core/src/sys/global.rs: One value for the module's lifetime, made on first use, from a shared static on one thread: a TypeScript module's own top-level `let`. The pair of a language feature, not of a file.
